solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: A king transfixed by cheerful prayers

indicators.note: something transfixed is pierced through, so these letters are skewered by the cheerful word around them

parts.note: rosy means cheerful or optimistic
R is the abbreviation for king, from Latin rex

explanation.surface: A monarch is struck by a series of happy prayers.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosary is a set sequence of Catholic prayers counted on beads.

clue.text: Review rules aid surplus

indicators.note: to review is to look over again, here taken as reworking the order of the letters

explanation.surface: A call to look again at the regulations governing extra financial support.
explanation.definitionFit: Something residual is left over, a remainder in excess of what was used.

clue.text: Orderly gets rid of untidy heap

parts.note: to ship off something is to send it away, get rid of it

indicators.note: an untidy heap is a messy one, so its letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A tidy person clears away a messy pile.
explanation.definitionFit: Shipshape is an idiom for neat and in good order, from the tidy state of a well-run vessel.

clue.text: Was in charge of police offensive

parts.note: to run something is to manage it, so ran is was in charge of
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police forces

explanation.surface: Someone once led an objectionable police unit.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancid describes something rank or foul-smelling, hence offensive to the senses.

clue.text: Undermine film with quite even characters

parts.note: Psycho is the Hitchcock thriller of 1960

indicators.note: the even-numbered characters of the word are picked, the second and fourth

explanation.surface: A film director sabotaged with a fairly level cast of characters.
explanation.definitionFit: To psych out an opponent is to unsettle them mentally, sapping their confidence.

clue.text: When mixing ripple puff, it's appropriate to show self-restraint

indicators.note: mixing the words stirs their letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A baker mixing a rippled puff pastry keeps calm about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'When' and 'appropriate to show' link the fodder to the definition; the apostrophe in 'it's' gives no letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A stiff upper lip is the idiom for stoical composure, refusing to show emotion under strain.

clue.text: Fraud on cruise line

parts.note: a con is a swindle or fraud
a cruise is a pleasure tour by sea

explanation.surface: A scam is run by a holiday shipping company.
explanation.definitionFit: A contour is an outline, or a line on a map joining points of equal height.

clue.text: Heeds call to attract attention of Turkish men

parts.note: O is an exclamation used to address or summon someone
beys were Turkish governors or men of rank

explanation.surface: Someone does what they are told when hailed by Turkish officials.
explanation.definitionFit: To obey is to follow orders, as to heed is to pay attention and act on advice.

clue.text: Abstainer renounces love beside lofty seesaw

indicators.note: renouncing something is giving it up, so these letters are dropped from the abstainer

parts.note: a teetotaller abstains from alcohol
love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O
lofty means tall

explanation.surface: A non-drinker gives up romance alongside a tall playground ride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beside' only links the two removed parts, which sit side by side in the abstainer's word.
explanation.definitionFit: To teeter is to wobble back and forth, the motion of a seesaw, used here as a verb.

clue.text: Child caught in heaven

indicators.note: the letter for caught is placed in the word for heaven

parts.note: Sion, a variant of Zion, is the heavenly city
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A child is captured in paradise.
explanation.definitionFit: A scion is a descendant or heir, a child of a family line.

clue.text: They patronise beginning of Easter, crossing part of threshold in church

indicators.note: the built-up piece goes inside the abbreviation for church

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: the opening letter crosses into the beam word, sitting within it

parts.note: a lintel is the beam above a doorway, the top of a threshold's frame

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Worshippers attend Easter's start, stepping over the door frame into church.
explanation.definitionFit: Clientele means a body of customers, people who patronise a business.

clue.text: C-collared by this new technology! It'll make you go green

definitions.text: C-collared by this new technology! It'll make you go green

parts.words: C-collared by this new technology! It'll make you go green
parts.note: C is the symbol for the element carbon, and being collared is being captured, so the clue describes a green technology that traps that element

explanation.surface: An eco gadget boasts that it will turn you into an environmentalist.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the process of trapping carbon dioxide emissions and storing them away from the atmosphere.

clue.text: Papers could be getting easier?

definitions.meaning: a file of documents on a subject
a doss is British slang for an easy task, so the whimsical adjective dossy would have this comparative form

explanation.definitionFit: A dossier is a collected file of papers on a person or topic.

clue.text: Index of success in game

indicators.note: the success letter is placed inside the word for the game

parts.note: footie is British informal for football
S is taken as a short form for success

explanation.surface: A measure of how well a team does on the pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: The FTSE 100 share index of the London Stock Exchange is nicknamed Footsie. S for success is not a standard abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Footsie is the spoken nickname of the FTSE 100, the main British share index.

clue.text: First man to become a mother

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially livestock

explanation.surface: The first human is to become a mother.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Adam is the first human created by God.

clue.text: Officer's punishment is substantial

definitions.meaning: a non-commissioned army rank above lance ...
as in the bodily punishment of beating
an obsolete sense meaning bodily, material or tangible

explanation.definitionFit: Corporal is an army rank, a kind of physical punishment, and archaically means bodily or material.

clue.text: What a baggage-handler might do with small letters

definitions.meaning: a porter might lower a case down from a rack

explanation.definitionFit: Lower-case letters are the small forms, named for the lower printer's tray that held them.

clue.text: Agreed to be perfectly healthy

definitions.meaning: a reply giving consent, all right then

explanation.definitionFit: Saying very well signals assent, and being very well means in fine health.

clue.text: Apprehended and barred after exchange with PC

indicators.note: the two letters named here swap places in the word for barred

parts.note: excepted means excluded or barred

explanation.surface: A suspect was arrested and locked up after a row with a police officer.
explanation.walkthrough: The C and P in the word for barred trade places, CEP becoming PEC.
explanation.definitionFit: To apprehend can mean to anticipate, especially with dread, so it matches being looked for in advance.

clue.text: Turn over a new leaf and get degree in organic compound

parts.note: PTO, please turn over, is printed at a page foot to send the reader to the next leaf
MA is a Master of Arts degree
taken as written

explanation.surface: A reformed character earns a qualification in chemistry.
explanation.walkthrough: The idiom for reforming oneself is really an instruction to flip the page.
explanation.definitionFit: A ptomaine, also spelt ptomain, is a nitrogen compound formed as protein decays.

clue.text: Pretty short message?

indicators.note: short means the word is cut, losing its final letter

parts.note: a tweet is a short online message

explanation.surface: Is a brief text message rather cute?
explanation.definitionFit: Twee describes something excessively pretty or quaint, sweet to the point of sentimentality.

clue.text: Lifts flaming issue

parts.note: ups as a verb means raises or lifts
flaming means burning hot

explanation.surface: Lifting something that is on fire causes trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: The upshot is the final outcome, the issue or result of a matter.

clue.text: Pink albino's declaration

definitions.meaning: to pink is to pierce or prick with a sword
an albino might say of themselves I am pale

explanation.definitionFit: To impale is to pierce through with a point, as pinking is a light stab.

clue.text: Might this event provide sexy spectacles in pages?

definitions.text: Might this event provide sexy spectacles in pages?

indicators.note: the sexy word and the spectacles sit in the pages abbreviation

parts.note: hot means sexy
OO looks like a pair of round spectacles

explanation.surface: Asking whether a staged publicity shoot will fill magazine pages with glamour.
explanation.definitionFit: A photo op is an event staged for press photographs, which might yield sexy pictures for the pages.

clue.text: Waste away before pale extremities are amputated

parts.note: off means away, as in going off

indicators.note: cutting off the end letters leaves only the middle of the word

explanation.surface: A patient wastes away before pale limbs are cut off.
explanation.definitionFit: Offal is the entrails and trimmings of a carcass, often thrown away as waste.

clue.text: Marine carnivore mounts attack on quarry

parts.note: to lam is to thrash or attack
quarry means prey, the hunted animal

explanation.surface: A sea predator launches an assault on its victim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounts' and 'on' join the definition to the pieces; a lamprey does latch onto its prey.
explanation.definitionFit: The lamprey is a jawless marine fish that feeds by sucking the blood of other fish.

clue.text: Mellivorous creature: the male is very loud with a protuberance

parts.note: he is the male pronoun
FF, fortissimo, is the musical mark for very loud
a lump is a bulge or protuberance

explanation.surface: Describing a honey-eating animal: a loud male with a bump.
explanation.walkthrough: Mellivorous means honey-eating; the creature is the imaginary animal Pooh fears in A. A. Milne's stories.
explanation.definitionFit: In Winnie-the-Pooh, these elephant-like beasts are thought to love honey, so they are honey-eaters.

clue.text: Gem of a wicket

parts.note: a wicket is a small gate

explanation.surface: A treasure found at the cricket stumps.
explanation.definitionFit: Agate is a banded semi-precious stone, a type of gem.

clue.text: Crack a pole's centre when under canvas outside

indicators.note: the camping word goes outside the other pieces

parts.note: being under canvas means camping in tents, so tented

indicators.note: the middle letter of the word is picked

explanation.surface: Breaking a tent pole in the middle while camping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crack' as an adjective means excellent, as in a crack shot.
explanation.definitionFit: A crack player is an expert, so the word means highly skilled.

clue.text: Spill beans and meat following first two parts of recipe

indicators.note: the meat word comes after the recipe opening
the opening two letters of the word are taken

parts.note: veal is calf meat

explanation.surface: A cook ends up with beans and veal after starting a recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: To reveal is to disclose a secret, which is what spilling the beans means.
